common.supervisor_behavior: sets an EXIT trap that records launcher exit code and UTC; invokes launch.sh; launcher starts watchdog; watchdog itself is the direct parent PID registered in the worker environment.

watchdog_child_environment.PHYSICAL_WATCHDOG_PARENT_PID: set by subreaper_watchdog.py to its os.getpid()
watchdog_child_environment.PHYSICAL_WATCHDOG_PHASE_PATH: set by subreaper_watchdog.py to the absolute --phase-path
watchdog_child_environment.PHYSICAL_NATIVE_CAPACITY: inherited task43_hp_adaptivity_resource_v1; watchdog computes reserve/launch/planning caps and exports its runtime facts

source/input manifest before hashes match the reviewed launch identity

common.worker_process_parent_rule: subreaper_watchdog sets PHYSICAL_WATCHDOG_PARENT_PID to its PID and passes the absolute --phase-path; the inner shell runs the ABI preflight as its own child, so that helper records but does not assert its immediate parent. The exec/taskset chain then replaces the watchdog child shell, and the actual A1/A2 worker asserts os.getppid() equals PHYSICAL_WATCHDOG_PARENT_PID.
